heroLead: A timer and stopwatch for Windows. Focus scenes, pure-time tracking, stats, and a compact always-on-top overlay.

about.title: About the product
about.desc: Focus and Break, timer and stopwatch, configurable scenes, pure-time tracking, and weekly stats. Data is stored locally on your device.

features.title: Features
features.f1: Two modes, nothing extra: Focus and Break
features.f2: Pure time — the timer pauses itself when you step away
features.f3: Set the time by scrubbing the digits: hold minutes or seconds and drag
features.f4: Five living scenes: ninja, activity chart, focus orbit, a gradually blooming light garden, and a tree that grows with your focus
features.f5: Always-on-top overlay, weekly chart, tray, and global hotkeys

howTo.title: How to Start
howTo.step1: Download the build for your operating system
howTo.step3: Scrub the digits to set your time and press start
howTo.step4: Track your focus on the weekly chart
